evidence.semantics: The per-frame SP regen tick still runs and resets its timer, but adds 0 instead of 10 (1 SP; SP is stored x10 at actor +0xCA). SP only refills from items, level-ups and other explicit sources.
evidence.runtime: Savestates/SP_Regen.ss0: English ROM regains 1 SP at frame +21; English+no_sp_regen stays at 0 for 1200 frames.

writes.note: SP regen tick: `adds r0,#0xa` (+1 SP, stored x10) becomes `adds r0,#0`; the strh and max-SP clamp after it are unchanged and harmless.
